review.prototype_intent: Clone usages are confirmed; broad derived-copy detection does not establish GoF intent. KeyValues is cfg-dependent and wraps a borrowed reference; this is not evidence of deep-copy isolation.
review.claim: RecordBuilder and MetadataBuilder construct internal products, set direct/nested members from input and build via derived clone of that same product field. No program execution, alias/lifetime proof or generic-specialization equality.

timing.note: Engine-only queries on prebuilt index/registry. View construction separate. Excludes parse/link, disk cache, CLI. p95 nearest rank describes sample only. Source manifests and engine hashes fixed. Timings are local observations, not cross-version speedup claims.
